newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's Moi makes cabinet reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's Moi makes cabinet reshuffle.

text.p: Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi unveiled a reshuffle on Wednesday that brought Nicholas Biwott back into the cabinet, five years after he had been dropped.

Biwott, a close aide of Moi from his minority Kalenjin tribe, was named minister in the presidency. The statement read over state radio said changes included the dropping of Kipkalia Kones, who had been minister in his office.
Biwott had been dismissed in November 1991 after allegations of corruption and was also a suspect in the inquiry into the 1990 murder of popular former foreign minister, Robert Ouko.

Moi demoted local government minister William ole Ntimama to the less important portfolio of national heritage, swapping positions with Francis Lotodo. Potters Momanyi was named as the new minister of tourism.
